title: Existence of a PCPP for every Boolean property
statement: For every natural number $n>0$ and every property $P$ of Boolean strings of length $n$, there is a probabilistically checkable proof system with proof length $2^{2^n}$ and a verifier making three nonadaptive queries, such that every string satisfying $P$ has a proof accepted with probability $1$. Moreover, for every $[0m\varepsilon\in[0,1]$, any input whose relative Hamming distance from every string satisfying $P$ is greater than $\varepsilon$ is rejected, for every proof, with probability greater than $\varepsilon/1000$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is an arbitrary property of Boolean strings of length $n$
